<b>Driftlins</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They reside on [[Mount Fay]], where their downy wings and cowl allow them to resist freezing temperatures.<ref>Driftlin [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Gentle glider of Mount Fay. Its downy wings and cowl allow it to resist even the most cutting cold."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Driftlins float in place, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. After a Driftlin is killed, a new one takes its place shortly after.

They are used primarily for traversal via [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bouncing]] or the [[Clawline]].

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Driftlins have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

The new Driftlin that spawns after defeating a black-threaded Driftlin is also black-threaded. Its void attack may differ from that of the previous one.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Lightly, lightly, oh so lightly...
* Drifty, drifty, oh so nicely...
* Mother, mother, gleam so brightly...
* Glidey! Glidey! Glidey!
}}

== Location ==
Driftlins can be found throughout [[Mount Fay]].

Two Driftlins in the northeastern part of Mount Fay disappear once [[Pinstress]] arrives there, and return only once she leaves.

==Trivia==
*The 1.0.27535 and 1.0.27776 versions of <i>Silksong</i> playable on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch respectively, which are older than the PC launch version (1.0.28324), have the Driftlin be named Snowdlin.<ref>[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GaNLkTTszFKFv55DZj3Iw1hTUi6gbstSR56WXizrMAI Silksong Switch full text] on Google Docs</ref>
* Driftlins are likely related to the [[Fayforn]] due to visual similarities and their Needolin dialogue.
* Driftlins have a [[Cut Content (Silksong)#Enemy Behaviours|cut]] "Blizzard Idle" behaviour, where they angle themselves and shake as if pushed by strong winds.
